title: Certificate
renewPending: A renewal is on its way.

source.custom: Own certificate, you renew it yourself

done.letsencrypt: Let's Encrypt is the source again. The own certificate serves until the new one is there.
done.renew: Renewal requested. The new certificate is there in a minute or two.
done.installed: Certificate installed and served over HTTPS.
done.csr: CSR created. Have it signed, then upload the certificate here without a key.

delete.question: Delete the certificate and its key?
delete.text: HTTPS is off, so nothing serves this certificate any more. A pending CSR is deleted too.

upload.title: Upload certificate
upload.chainHint: The intermediate certificates of your CA, if they are not in the certificate field.
upload.keyWithCSR: Private key (leave empty for the key of the CSR)
upload.keyHint: PEM without passphrase. RSA with at least 2048 bits, or ECDSA P-256 or P-384.
upload.keyNotice: The key passes through your browser and the panel.
upload.keyNoticeText: It is stored on the server only, readable by root. With “Create CSR” the key never leaves the server.
upload.allowUntrusted: Not publicly trusted (internal CA or self-signed): install anyway

csr.intro: The server creates a key that never leaves it, and a certificate signing request (CSR) for its domains. Have the CSR signed by your CA, then upload the certificate here without a key.
csr.label: Certificate signing request
csr.hint: Waiting for its certificate. Creating a new one replaces the key.

problems.certPEM: Paste the certificate in PEM form, starting with -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----.
problems.chainPEM: The chain must be PEM certificates, or leave it empty.
problems.chainSize: Certificate and chain are too large (at most 32 KiB together).
problems.keyInCert: A private key belongs in the key field, not with the certificates.
problems.noKey: Paste the private key, or create a CSR first.
problems.encrypted: The key is protected by a passphrase. Remove it first (openssl pkey -in key.pem -out plain.pem).
problems.keyPEM: Paste the private key in PEM form, starting with -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----.
problems.keySize: The key is too large (at most 16 KiB).
